rule: Optimistic UI applies only when ALL criteria are met; otherwise use non-optimistic.

criteria.check: success rate ≥ 99% in production (measured, not assumed)
repeating the operation produces the same result
blastRadius.scope ∈ {self, workspace} AND count ≤ 1; critical/high refused
server response p95 ≤ 3s; beyond this, optimistic obscures true status

refusal: Optimistic UI without rollback contract — silent failure on error.
Optimistic UI on operations whose true success depends on server-side validation (e.g., unique-username check).
Optimistic UI where the user needs to *see* the server's response (e.g., payment confirmation number).
